summary.architectural_role: Secure Page Table Monitor (SPTM) is Apple's hypervisor-level memory supervisor executing in Guarded EL2 (GL2) on SoC T8150 under ARMv8.6+ Guarded Execution Feature (GXF). SPTM completely deprecates legacy Page Table Protection Layer (PPL) and APRR by enforcing Stage-2 translation isolation over the XNU kernel (EL1), mediating all physical memory frame retyping via 42 discrete function IDs and 17 dispatch tables, and strictly arbitrating hardware CTRR, GAPF, DART, and SART protection registers.

boot_sequence.description: Primary CPU enters at __start (0xfffffff0270bc388) and branches to 0xfffffff0270bf000; clears OSLAR_EL1, masks DAIF asynchronous interrupts, and verifies boot arguments pointer from iBoot.

Inspects CurrentEL (asserts CurrentEL == 8 for EL2) and configures HCR_EL2 with TGE (bit 27) and E2H (bit 34) to enable Virtualization Host Extensions (VHE), zeroes CNTVOFF_EL2, and initializes HCRX_EL2.

Builds 3-level translation tables with 16KB granules, configures TCR_EL1 to 0x310800336511a511, loads TTBR0_EL1 and TTBR1_EL1, derives stack canary via pacga on 'STACKGRD', and enables MMU via SCTLR_EL1 (0x12001010fc14793d).
Registers __exc vector base (0xfffffff027118000) into GL2_VBAR (S3_6_C15_C10_2), programs GL2 Entry Vector (S3_6_C15_C8_1) and Exit Vector (S3_6_C15_C8_2), and activates GXF.

page_table_hierarchies.guest_stage2_root_table: XNU_STAGE2_ROOT_TABLE (Type 24, physical base mapped in VTTBR_EL2)

ttbr_controls.description: Guest user space translation table base register shadow
Guest kernel space translation table base register shadow
Virtualization Translation Table Base Register (holds 48-bit PA and 16-bit VMID)
Virtualization Translation Control Register (0x061f000061002000 for 16KB granule)

papt_management.description: Physical Address Page Table (PAPT) tracking engine maintaining physical frame ownership and cryptographic tags across memory domains.

sapt_management.description: Secure Apple Remap Table (SAPT) supervisor preventing unauthorized aperture mapping into peripheral DMA spaces.

page_retyping.description: Dynamic memory retyping engine mediating transitions between 59 distinct physical frame types to ensure strict privilege boundaries.
page_retyping.pinned_frames_handling: Pinned kernel frames (XNU_ROZONE, SPTM_PAGE_TABLE) cannot be retyped to generic XNU_DEFAULT without explicit unmap and cryptographic deauthorization.

stage2_tlb_operations.tlb_broadcast_routine: TLBI IPAS2E1IS (Stage-2 Inner-Shareable Invalidation by Intermediate Physical Address)
stage2_tlb_operations.bootstrap_tlbi_routine: TLBI VMALLE1IS (Invalidate all Stage-1 and Stage-2 translations for current VMID)
stage2_tlb_operations.gmmu_tlbi_handling: Guarded MMU TLB invalidation enforced with 8-byte aligned verification registers.

ctrr_protection.description: Configurable Translation Read-Only Region (CTRR) locking firmware code and read-only structures in hardware registers, preventing write operations even from EL2 hypervisor context.

gapf_protection.description: Guarded Address Protection Filter (GAPF) enforcing hardware aperture filtering across CPU and AOP/coprocessor memory buses.

el2_tag_offset.lock_verification: Evaluates MTE/PAC memory tag offsets at EL2 boot and commits lock bit before passing execution to XNU.
el2_tag_offset.mismatch_handling: Fatal monitor panic and hardware halt upon tag offset discrepancy.

gmmu_tlbi_verification.description: Guarded Memory Management Unit TLBI operation verification requiring 8-byte alignment on all TLB shootdown descriptor blocks.

dart_and_sart_registers.t8110_dart_clock_protection: Hardware clock gating and write-lockout registers for t8110dart DART Gen3 IOMMU units.
dart_and_sart_registers.relaxed_rw_protections: Restricted DMA read-write aperture boundaries preventing peripheral DMA controllers from addressing SPTM or TXM memory ranges.
dart_and_sart_registers.sart_state_machine: Secure Apple Remap Table state machine hardware controller for coprocessor aperture isolation.
dart_and_sart_registers.shart_controller: Shared Hardware Address Remap Table controller for inter-SoC memory mediation.

io_filter_registers.alignment_checks: Enforces 4-byte and 8-byte memory alignment on all MMIO writes directed to protected hardware registers.
io_filter_registers.bounds_checks: Asserts destination physical address falls within certified SoC peripheral aperture ranges.

function_ids.name: SPTM_FUNCTIONID_LOCKDOWN
function_ids.description: Initiates monitor hardware lockdown, transitions CTRR/GAPF to read-only, and seals early boot structures.

function_ids.name: SPTM_FUNCTIONID_RETYPE
function_ids.description: Validates and executes dynamic physical frame retyping between authenticated domain types (e.g. XNU_DEFAULT to XNU_PAGE_TABLE).

function_ids.name: SPTM_FUNCTIONID_MAP_PAGE
function_ids.description: Installs a validated Stage-1 page table entry for guest virtual addresses, preventing executable mapping without TXM authorization.

function_ids.name: SPTM_FUNCTIONID_MAP_TABLE
function_ids.description: Allocates and links an intermediate translation table level into the active guest hierarchy.

function_ids.name: SPTM_FUNCTIONID_UNMAP_TABLE
function_ids.description: Unlinks and deallocates an intermediate page table level after flushing associated TLB cache lines.

function_ids.name: SPTM_FUNCTIONID_UPDATE_REGION
function_ids.description: Modifies access permissions (Read/Write/Execute) across a contiguous virtual memory range.

function_ids.name: SPTM_FUNCTIONID_UPDATE_DISJOINT
function_ids.description: Applies permission updates across non-contiguous physical memory frames in a single atomic transaction.

function_ids.name: SPTM_FUNCTIONID_UNMAP_REGION
function_ids.description: Revokes mappings and restores physical frames across a designated guest virtual range.

function_ids.name: SPTM_FUNCTIONID_UNMAP_DISJOINT
function_ids.description: Revokes discontinuous page mappings across disjoint address ranges.

function_ids.name: SPTM_FUNCTIONID_CONFIGURE_SHAREDREGION
function_ids.description: Configures system shared region root tables (dyld shared cache apertures) with enforced read-only boundaries.

function_ids.name: SPTM_FUNCTIONID_NEST_REGION
function_ids.description: Nests a shared sub-hierarchy into a guest process address space with shared translation caching.

function_ids.name: SPTM_FUNCTIONID_UNNEST_REGION
function_ids.description: Detaches a nested translation sub-hierarchy and purges associated guest TLB entries.

function_ids.name: SPTM_FUNCTIONID_CONFIGURE_ROOT
function_ids.description: Initializes and authenticates a guest user-space or kernel root translation table (TTBR0/TTBR1).

function_ids.name: SPTM_FUNCTIONID_SWITCH_ROOT
function_ids.description: Executes context switch by updating guest TTBR0_EL12 and validating ASID generation counters.

function_ids.name: SPTM_FUNCTIONID_REGISTER_CPU
function_ids.description: Registers a secondary CPU core during SMP warm boot and configures per-CPU SPTM context data structures.

function_ids.name: SPTM_FUNCTIONID_FIXUPS_COMPLETE
function_ids.description: Signals completion of chained pointer rebasing and locks down authenticated pointer data segments.

function_ids.name: SPTM_FUNCTIONID_SIGN_USER_POINTER
function_ids.description: Signs a user-space return pointer or function pointer using hardware PAC with domain-specific modifiers.

function_ids.name: SPTM_FUNCTIONID_AUTH_USER_POINTER
function_ids.description: Authenticates a user-space PAC-signed pointer, trapping on signature failure.

function_ids.name: SPTM_FUNCTIONID_REGISTER_EXC_RETURN
function_ids.description: Registers an authenticated exception return context (SPSR, ELR) for safe return to Lower EL.

function_ids.name: SPTM_FUNCTIONID_CPU_ID
function_ids.description: Returns physical hardware CPU identification and core affinity masks.

function_ids.name: SPTM_FUNCTIONID_SLIDE_REGION
function_ids.description: Adjusts address space layout randomization (ASLR) slides for mapped firmware modules.

function_ids.name: SPTM_FUNCTIONID_UPDATE_DISJOINT_MULTIPAGE
function_ids.description: Optimized bulk permission update for discontinuous multi-page memory spans.

function_ids.name: SPTM_FUNCTIONID_GUEST_VA_TO_IPA
function_ids.description: Translates a guest virtual address to Intermediate Physical Address (IPA) via Stage-1 address walk.

function_ids.name: SPTM_FUNCTIONID_GUEST_STAGE1_TLBOP
function_ids.description: Executes Stage-1 TLB invalidation operations across inner-shareable core domains.

function_ids.name: SPTM_FUNCTIONID_GUEST_STAGE2_TLBOP
function_ids.description: Executes Stage-2 TLB invalidation operations (TLBI IPAS2E1IS) ensuring hypervisor-level cache coherency.

function_ids.name: SPTM_FUNCTIONID_GUEST_DISPATCH
function_ids.description: Dispatches an authorized hypercall invocation from guest EL1 to monitor subsystem.

function_ids.name: SPTM_FUNCTIONID_GUEST_EXIT
function_ids.description: Returns execution from Guarded EL2 monitor context back to calling guest domain.

function_ids.name: SPTM_FUNCTIONID_HIB_BEGIN
function_ids.description: Prepares system memory for hibernation by freezing dynamic page retyping and capturing wired state.

function_ids.name: SPTM_FUNCTIONID_HIB_VERIFY_HASH_NON_WIRED
function_ids.description: Validates cryptographic SHA-256 hash tree over non-wired hibernation memory pages.

function_ids.name: SPTM_FUNCTIONID_HIB_FINALIZE_NON_WIRED
function_ids.description: Finalizes hibernation restore sequence, verifying NVMe image HMAC before unfreezing execution.

function_ids.name: SPTM_FUNCTIONID_IOFILTER_PROTECTED_WRITE
function_ids.description: Performs bounds-checked, aligned MMIO writes to protected hardware peripheral registers.

function_ids.name: SPTM_FUNCTIONID_SPTM_TAG_PAPT_MULTIPAGE
function_ids.description: Applies cryptographic PAPT tags across multiple physical memory frames to assert monitor ownership.

function_ids.name: SPTM_FUNCTIONID_SPTM_UNTAG_PAPT_MULTIPAGE
function_ids.description: Removes PAPT tags from physical frames upon deallocation or transition to external coprocessor domain.

function_ids.name: SPTM_FUNCTIONID_SET_SHARED_REGION
function_ids.description: Registers the global system shared cache physical memory aperture with Stage-2 read-only attributes.

function_ids.name: SPTM_FUNCTIONID_BATCH_SIGN_USER_POINTER
function_ids.description: High-throughput batch PAC signing service for userland execution runtimes.

function_ids.name: SPTM_FUNCTIONID_SURT_ALLOC
function_ids.description: Allocates a Subpage User Root Table (SURT) structure for fine-grained page protection.

function_ids.name: SPTM_FUNCTIONID_SURT_FREE
function_ids.description: Deallocates a Subpage User Root Table structure and returns physical pages to pool.

function_ids.name: SPTM_FUNCTIONID_CONDEMN_LEAF_TABLE
function_ids.description: Marks a leaf translation table as condemned, prohibiting further PTE installations prior to teardown.

function_ids.name: SPTM_FUNCTIONID_UNCONDEMN_LEAF_TABLE
function_ids.description: Restores a previously condemned leaf translation table if teardown was aborted.

function_ids.name: SPTM_FUNCTIONID_SPTM_SERIAL_PUTC
function_ids.description: Outputs a single character to hardware UART serial console for low-level monitor debugging.

function_ids.name: SPTM_FUNCTIONID_SPTM_SERIAL_DISABLE
function_ids.description: Disables hardware UART serial output upon completion of system bootstrap.

function_ids.name: SPTM_FUNCTIONID_OUTPUT_AREA
function_ids.description: Manages dedicated circular telemetry and error logging buffer in secure memory.

domains.role: SPTM Monitor execution, stage-2 MMU supervisor
Temporary XNU Read-Only Zone write window
Standard user space applications and daemons
JIT compiler write window for WebKit

cross_domain_state_machine.description: Initial CPU reset state before MMU or VHE configuration
Early monitor bootstrapping and translation table setup
Virtualization Host Extensions enabled with EL2 host mode
XNU kernel executing in EL1 context under Stage-2 supervision
TXM executing in Guarded EL1 context for Image4 authentication
ExclaveCore / Secure Kernel active in isolated domain
Terminal panic state with halted execution and preserved crash registers

inter_domain_endpoints.purpose: Supervisor call (svc #0) requesting page table mapping or retyping
Guarded hypercall (0xd4e00000) requesting Stage-2 executable permission locks
Hypervisor call (hvc) for ExclaveCore memory and IPC domain configuration
GXF GENTER_EL1 invocation for code signing evaluation and TrustCache lookup

hibernation_architecture.hmac_validation: SPTM verifies HMAC-SHA256 signature across hibernation header structures before restoring physical page states from NVMe swap image.
hibernation_architecture.header_verification: Validates image size, memory range bounds, wired page count, and CPU context restore frames.
